title: Third Season of 'Dorohedoro' Announced
content: • The 11th and final episode of Dorohedoro Season 2 revealed on Thursday that the third season is in production. The official website also released an illustration (pictured) drawn by the series' director, Yuuichirou Hayashi , to commemorate the announcement.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves Game Streams New Animated Video for Mr. Karate
content: SNK revealed on Wednesday a new animated trailer for its Fatal Fury City of the Wolves fighting game , highlighting the DLC character Mr. Karate, who joined the roster on Wednesday as part of the game's Season Pass 2.

title: One Piece Creator Visits Live-Action Set For Season 3 Preview
content: Following the second season of Netflix’s One Piece , the stage is set for Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates to finally arrive in the live-action locale of Alabasta. Hoping to trim down the time between seasons, filming has already begun on One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta .

title: Dorohedoro Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The staff for the second anime season based on Q Hayashida 's Dorohedoro manga announced on Wednesday that the series is getting a third season. Director Yuichiro Hayashi shared a special commemorative illustration featuring Haru singing for the sequel.
